title: Retention, deletion and text privacy

subtasks.description: Define explicit immediate/finite/indefinite retention semantics and migrate the current ambiguous zero value safely.
subtasks.progress_note: Explicit retention modes (ADR 0020): Workspace.retention_mode finite|indefinite|immediate|legacy_unresolved with check constraint ck_workspace_retention_mode (days >= 1 only under finite, 0 otherwise); expiry stamped at ingestion from the workspace row via backend/services/retention_policy.py (finite: now+days; immediate: now; indefinite/legacy: none) and is_age_based_deletion_enabled re-checked by sweeps before acting on a stored expiry. Admin API: retention_mode in GET/PATCH /admin/workspace-settings (workspace:manage + CSRF, audited by field name); bare retention_days 0 refused as ambiguous; days under indefinite/immediate need the mode; finite needs a positive number; legacy_unresolved cannot be chosen; RETENTION_DAYS_DEFAULT validated 1..3650. Migration c3e7a9d2b5f1: days>=1 -> FINITE, days=0 -> LEGACY_UNRESOLVED (nothing reinterpreted or purged), lossless downgrade. Console: policy selector, days only for finite, legacy warning. Verified locally: ruff clean on changed files; SQLite retention + admin API 18 passed / 1 skipped; PostgreSQL 16.15 (retention policy incl. migration round trip with a legacy zero row and the constraint, admin API, RLS, tenant scope, media lifecycle) 36 passed; infra/ci/check-migrations.sh exit 0 and alembic downgrade -1 / upgrade head / check clean on homayar_mig; frontend tsc+vite build, eslint, vitest 12 passed. No job deletes by age yet (T03). Product commit ffa14b548f8f02cea918cba5c362108e53908129.

subtasks.description: Add legal-hold ownership, reason, expiry/review and audited release; separate hold from ordinary user preference.
subtasks.progress_note: Legal hold as a compliance action separate from deletion preferences: permission legal_hold:manage (owner only; admins excluded; never an API-key scope) on POST /meetings/{id}/legal-hold (every live object of a live conversation), POST /media/{id}/legal-hold (one object, also of a deleted conversation) and POST /media/{id}/legal-hold/release. A hold records who placed it, a reason (3-200 chars, whitespace-normalised) and a review date (future, <= 3650 days; constraint ck_media_hold_review, column legal_hold_review_at, migration d4a8c1e7b2f9 with lossless downgrade); placement is idempotent (a repeat never rewrites owner/reason/review); a hold overrides retention expiry, a recorded deletion request, orphan classification and temporary cleanup until released, and cannot be placed on deleted bytes (409 already_deleted: the irreversible boundary is documented, a hold never restores). Release needs its own reason, is audited (release_reason, held_since, deletion_pending) and resumes a recorded deletion request state-first, bytes-second (a failed removal stays deletion_pending for the WP05-T04 sweep). The reconciliation sweep counts overdue reviews (holds_review_due) with a warning log and never acts on them. Media responses expose legal_hold_by_user_id and legal_hold_review_at, never the storage key. Verified locally: ruff clean on changed files; SQLite (legal hold, media lifecycle, authorization matrix incl. permission/scope/route inventories, reconciliation, API keys, meetings API, job processor) 37 passed / 3 skipped; PostgreSQL 16.15 (legal hold, lifecycle, RLS, reconciliation, matrix, tenant scope, retention) 50 passed; check-migrations.sh exit 0; alembic downgrade -1 / upgrade head / check clean on homayar_mig with both new constraints present. No organisation-level or platform-operator hold; no console UI yet. Product commit 3622db3effc8e3272f935ed9894ae495f64664f8.

subtasks.description: Implement tombstone-first access denial, durable object/derived-data purge jobs and retry reconciliation.
subtasks.progress_note: Tombstone-first deletion and durable purge (ADR 0021): tombstone_meeting commits deleted_at on meeting and recording, revokes share links, invalidates checkpoints, requests deletion of every media object (holds keep bytes) and inserts a conversation_purges row (tenant table, RLS, migration e6c2a9f4d1b8, no backfill of older tombstones). run_purge_attempt claims with FOR UPDATE SKIP LOCKED and moves next_attempt_at forward, removes derived content rows (revisions, segments, analysis, evidence, summary, actions, speakers, share recipients), empties title and filename, removes bytes state-first behind the media row lock and closes with a non-content receipt; usage, provider usage, stage runs, audit, ingestion and media rows are kept. Storage errors (denied/unavailable/failed) keep deletion_pending + PENDING storage_pending with exponential backoff; after RETENTION_PURGE_MAX_ATTEMPTS the purge is FAILED, audited and alerted until requeue_failed_purge. A legal hold defers the whole purge (content, stage outputs, held bytes) without spending an attempt; the WP06 artifact sweep skips held deleted conversations; overdue reviews never release; release nudges the purge. Retention sweep jobs/retention_purge.py (beat retention-purge) tombstones only when, under workspace/meeting row locks, the mode is finite or immediate, expiry <= now, no job queued/running (terminal jobs untouched, do not block) and nothing held; indefinite and legacy_unresolved never act. Race fixes: delete_objects re-locks/re-reads at the point of no return; hold routes lock media rows; processor and publish_checkpoint lock the meeting row after the lease fence. Verified locally: ruff clean on changed files; new test_retention_purge.py SQLite 12 passed / 3 skipped (PostgreSQL-only), PostgreSQL 16.15 15 passed; PostgreSQL batch of 19 files (purge, hold, lifecycle, RLS, reconciliation, matrix, retention, tenant scope, checkpoints, processor, leases, ledger, insights/shares, meetings, postgres guarantees, share policies, API keys, revisions, usage) 149 passed; full SQLite suite 423 passed / 81 skipped; check-migrations.sh exit 0; alembic downgrade -1 / upgrade head / check clean on homayar_mig with forced RLS and policy on conversation_purges. Presigned URLs are revoked only by expiry; restores are WP07-T04. Product commit 2dcb7e640983e44dca1d6c6c9248d487ef3c5e36.

subtasks.description: Reapply deletion tombstones after restore and document backup expiry rather than promising instant backup erasure.
subtasks.progress_note: Tombstone journal outside the backups and reapply after restore (ADR 0022): every tombstone is appended after its commit to TOMBSTONE_JOURNAL_DIR (per-day JSON lines, O_APPEND + fsync, mode 0600, SHA-256 per line; ids, reason, timestamp and opaque object keys only, held objects omitted). conversation_purges.journaled_at is the outbox marker (migration f3d7b1e9a5c4 with reapplied_at); the delete route journals inline, the retention sweep writes the backlog and reports journal_backlog; a journal failure never blocks deletion; startup warns in staging/production without a journal. python -m backend.jobs.tombstone_reapply reapply re-tombstones journaled conversations that a restore brought back alive (queued/running jobs cancelled, links revoked, holds in the restored database respected), reopens the purge (reapplied_at) so restored content rows and bytes are removed again (purge re-deletes keys of already closed rows), runs one attempt; verify exits non-zero while any journaled conversation is alive or a line fails its checksum; --remove-unknown-keys only for conversations unknown to the restored database and never for referenced keys. Website: Compose volume tombstone_journal / TOMBSTONE_JOURNAL_PATH on api and worker, service tombstone-reapply (profile restore), infra/scripts/reapply-tombstones.sh, restore-postgres.sh reminder, runbook section 'Deletion Tombstones and Backup Expiry' (backups expire under owner-set retention; no instant backup erasure promised) and DR order step. Verified locally: ruff clean on changed files; test_tombstone_reapply.py SQLite 9 passed (incl. real sqlite3 backup/restore drill of DB and object store), PostgreSQL 16.15 with test_retention_purge.py 23 passed / 1 skipped (SQLite-only drill); full SQLite suite 432 passed / 81 skipped; check-migrations.sh exit 0; alembic downgrade -1 / upgrade head / check clean; docker compose config --quiet for onprem, onprem+restore and cloud. Not executed: pg_dump/pg_restore drill on the Compose stack (WP20 restore rehearsal). Product commit 4b3038c3e1e5b5bd682ef5c7c43523252bff8da8.

subtasks.description: Add Persian/English text PII detection, configurable classes and restricted original-to-redacted mappings.
subtasks.progress_note: Deterministic text PII detection, redacted versions and restricted mappings (ADR 0023): backend/privacy/text_pii.py (DETECTOR_VERSION text-pii/1) detects email, phone (Iranian mobile/landline in every common spelling, +/00 international), ir_national_id (check digit), bank_card (Luhn), iban (mod 97) and ir_postal_code (keyword-anchored), with Persian/Arabic-Indic digit and separator normalisation and offsets on the original text; names, addresses, spelled-out or split numbers are not detected (disclosed residual risk; not anonymisation, never audio masking). Workspace policy pii_redaction_enabled (default off, backfilled off) and pii_redaction_classes (supported classes, at least one) via PATCH /admin/workspace-settings (workspace:manage, audited). redact_revision creates one immutable version per (revision, digest of detector version + sorted classes) with stable placeholders; originals only as AES-256-GCM ciphertext in pii_mappings (AAD binds tenant, redaction, placeholder; PII_MAPPING_KEYS keyring with PII_MAPPING_ACTIVE_KEY_ID, rotation by key id; no key = nothing retained); reveal_placeholder audits pii.revealed without the value. transcript_redactions, redacted_segments, pii_mappings under forced RLS (migration a8e4c2f6d0b3), removed by the conversation purge. Verified locally: ruff clean on changed files; SQLite test_text_pii.py + test_admin_api.py 50 passed / 1 skipped; PostgreSQL 16.15 text PII, admin API, retention purge, tombstone reapply and RLS 84 passed / 1 skipped (after fixing the admin settings key-set assertion that failed in the first batch); full SQLite suite 482 passed / 82 skipped; check-migrations.sh exit 0; alembic downgrade -1 / upgrade head / check clean. Engineering gate only: recall/precision measured on a small synthetic annotated set; the F16 measurement on a separately annotated representative set is pending data. Not yet: pipeline-created versions, routing of analysis/retrieval/export/providers, reveal route, console control (WP07-T06). Product commit 28792cc0ea3d81cfc77ca8e1289ffb14e97758a3.

subtasks.description: Route permitted analysis/retrieval/export to the correct redacted or original version and record policy provenance.
subtasks.progress_note: Routing to the redacted or original version with policy provenance (ADR 0024): choose_view/MeetingView (backend/privacy/transcript_view.py) make the redacted version the default for every caller under an enforced workspace policy; the original needs the new owner-only pii:original_access (never an API-key scope) and an explicit ?view=original, audited transcript.original_accessed. Transcript, evidence (offsets mapped and widened to whole placeholders), summary, actions and export (json/txt/srt/vtt, privacy provenance block with view, detector version, classes, policy digest, redacted version id, analysis input view and the residual-risk notice) render through the view; share view/export always redacted under a policy (computed, the share session never writes); search re-checks candidates against redacted texts only (no oracle); corrections and action writes restore shown placeholders to the originals. The processor snapshots the policy at claim, sends only redacted turns/text to the intelligence provider, stores the redacted version with the revision, adds the policy digest to the intelligence checkpoint identity and records analysis_runs.input_view/input_policy_digest (migration b5d9e3a1c7f2, ck_analysis_run_input_view, existing rows original). POST /meetings/{id}/transcript/redactions/{rid}/reveal: owner, CSRF, reason, audited pii.revealed without the value; changing the redaction policy needs pii:original_access. Verified locally: ruff clean on changed files; test_privacy_routing.py SQLite 9 passed / 1 skipped; affected SQLite suites 120 passed / 8 skipped; PostgreSQL 16.15 batch 110 passed and test_privacy_routing.py 10 passed (incl. concurrent first reads creating one version); full SQLite suite 491 passed / 83 skipped; check-migrations.sh exit 0; alembic downgrade -1 / upgrade head / check clean. Not done: console policy/view/reveal UI (WP14); original transcript rows stay plaintext (access-controlled); pre-policy analysis outputs redacted at read time only; checkpoint-identity switch between attempts reviewed, not tested. Product commit 9ac4892416381829a2d90a179807c0f76c0cf880.
